name: Platinum Vape Disposable | Mean Green
description:
Sharp. Sweet. Built for the bold.

Mean Green hits with a tangy mix of green apple, citrus, and a hint of sour candy that wakes up your senses and keeps the energy rolling. This high-powered sativa distillate delivers a crisp, clean head high that sparks creativity, focus, and all-day motivation.

Made with pure Platinum distillate and precision airflow tech, this rechargeable 2G all-in-one gives you smooth draws, big flavor, and that unmistakable Platinum punch.

Flavor Profile: Green Apple • Citrus • Sour Candy

Effect: Energized • Focused • Uplifted

Device: Rechargeable 2G Distillate Disposable • All-In-One • Dual Coil Design
